data.exact_reserve_text: Claims incurred, net of reinsurance, include adverse prior year development of GBP 12.3m (2021: favourable development of GBP 5.1m). Prior year claims development is analysed by line of business in the table below.

prior_year_events.event_name: Commutation of cession business attaching to 2018-2020 underwriting years
prior_year_events.impact_description: The cession business attaching to the 2018 to 2020 underwriting years of account was commuted effective 30 November 2022. The liability of the Syndicate for future claims therefore ceased. Final premiums and claims on these years were GBP 68.1m and GBP 56.9m respectively.

named_events.loss_description: The catastrophe loss ratio for the year has improved, despite exposure to Hurricane Ian.
The syndicate has limited exposure to the conflict in Ukraine, with ultimate losses currently estimated to be GBP 1.5m.

data.standardized_narrative: On a gross basis the claims development triangle indicates a net release of approximately GBP 14.45m on prior years (primarily older underwriting years 2018-2020). The P&L however records an adverse prior year development on a net basis of GBP 12.3m, reflecting the effect of reinsurance and other movements (including commutation of cessions on 2018-2020). Drivers cited in the report include favourable claims experience in certain areas, the impact of the inflationary environment on reserving, and movements in reinsurance recoveries. Named current year events included Hurricane Ian and limited exposure to the conflict in Ukraine.
raw_causal_phrases: The current inflationary environment impacted the Syndicate's results and is reflected in the reserving results

data.data_quality_notes: Gross prior year development was calculated from the gross claims development triangle (triangle in GBP 000s) and yields a net release of ~GBP 14.45m. The report also states an adverse prior year development of GBP 12.3m on a net (after reinsurance) basis - the difference is due to reinsurance recoveries and the commutation of cessions affecting the relationship between gross and net movements. Per-LOB prior year movements in the notes appear only on a net basis; gross per-LOB movements were not provided. Where per-LOB figures are reported above they are taken from net P&L movement lines and carry lower confidence.
